commit_message: Implement ADR 0151 headless MCP writer ownership
pr_title: Implement ADR 0151 headless MCP writer ownership
pr_body: Implements ADR 0151 on the current main baseline. Adds a GUI-free headless MCP host over the existing engine-mcp inventory, extends the existing OS-backed per-project lease to explicit Editor/headless writer ownership, preserves read-only saved-file coexistence, persists writer mutations through canonical serializers, and updates accepted architecture/spec documentation. Root workspace membership and Cargo.lock change, so Windows Validation must run in full mode. Visual Validation is not required because this change has no visible Editor/Launcher presentation changes.
